final: SELECT a.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(A11) FROM district) as salary_gap FROM account a JOIN disp dp ON a.account_id = dp.account_id WHERE dp.client_id = (SELECT c.client_id FROM client c WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'))
